name: explore
line: turn it into a view you can explore, with the real rows one key below
writer: Claude, in the main conversation, guided by SKILL.md, saving the view with `lean save`

keys.◂ ▸: turn the selected knob (the first, when none is selected); with shift, ten places
keys.tab: the next part; shift+tab the one before
keys.↵: the real rows of the selected part, read back through the kernel; again closes them
